description: Reads one insurance document: a file on this machine (file_path) or an https link (url). PDF, PNG, JPG, HEIC, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, .eml or ZIP. Without workflow or schema you get our standard schema (everything we read); with the person's JSON Schema, their shape; with a workflow, its targets. Returns the result if it ends within wait_seconds (most documents take 40–170 s), else the job id for get_job. Each field: status (accepted, resolved, disputed, missing), value, quote and page; a missing field's absence says why. A file of several documents lists each with its own job_id. Costs $0.15 plus model usage.

fields.description: Only fields whose path starts with one of these, e.g. ["named_insured", "vehicles"]: for a long document.

file_path.description: A document on this machine (absolute, or relative to the project).

only.description: Only fields with these statuses, e.g. ["disputed"].

schema.description: The person's JSON Schema, as an object.

schema_file.description: Or the path of their JSON Schema file.

url.description: An https link we can fetch (public or signed).

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the end, in seconds (default 45, at most 55: many clients give up at 60). If it isn't done by then, you get the job id: call get_job.

workflow.description: Run one of the person's workflows (id or slug; append @3 or @draft to pin a version).

name: extract_document
title: Read a document
